method:
QA of the six Heather files AS NOW SHIPPED in assets/ (final integration, 2026-11-02), by the method of
b4qa_voice_review/tools/applied_qa.py: the manifest file name and the FNV-1a fingerprint of the
canonical script; provenance (FOUNDER_FINAL source = the logged raw); script identity by offline
ASR (faster-whisper small.en) on the shipping .m4a; lead-in, tail, last 10 ms, true peak,
integrated / max momentary / max short-term loudness; that the file IS the approved performance
(waveform correlation against its source take, trimmed and at the logged gain). Plus: the MP4
movie-header duration the app sees (old vs new), the pause-bed figure (2026-11-02 method,
digital-silence windows excluded), and voice identity (spectrum percentile and pitch vs Heather's
own shipping parts, from the final-round QA). Plus a chain check: the frozen rule run on the
FOUNDER_FINAL source with its extra gain reproduces the shipping file byte-for-byte.
Usage: python -I applied_qa.py <repo>
